message:
good ride, that route is one of the better ones on the island. here's how i'd break it up:

the first natural stop is around Seminyak/Kerobokan as you head south, but honestly the stretch gets more interesting once you're past Kuta and hitting the Bukit peninsula. that's where the road opens up and the views start.

Balangan Beach is worth a pull-off on the way down, it's one of the quieter ones on the Bukit and sits right on the route before you drop into Uluwatu proper. good for a stretch and a look at the surf.

then once you're close to Uluwatu, Ulu Cliffhouse is right on the clifftop road, [burnt](kebi://venue/13d8bb71-e05e-4b51-95db-c709aecae1c7) is the restaurant there and it's a solid spot to sit with a drink and look out over the water before the sun starts moving. it's about 3pm now so you'd hit it at a nice time, the light gets good in the late afternoon.

if you want to land somewhere with a bit more energy at the end, [Single Fin](kebi://venue/2c41a3f7-c5cb-4782-b441-a8535825c865) is the classic Uluwatu cliff bar, Sunday arvo sessions there are a thing, so it'll already be going by the time you arrive. that's a proper destination to finish on rather than just a stop.

are you planning to stay down in Uluwatu for the evening or riding back tonight? changes whether Single Fin makes sense as your anchor or just a quick one.
